data.name: ShortcutTipFormat
data.comment: A tooltip with a shortcut. {0} the control's name ("New project"), {1} its shortcut ("Ctrl+N").

data.name: ChooseFolderShortcut
data.comment: Choose folder's shortcut, in a tooltip and beside the Add photos menu item. The letter O is fixed; translate only "Ctrl", as Windows names that key on a keyboard of your language.

data.name: ChooseFolderKeys
data.comment: Choose folder's shortcut as a screen reader names it. Translate only "Control", as Windows names that key in your language.

data.name: ChoosePhotosShortcut
data.comment: Choose photos' shortcut, in a tooltip and beside the Add photos menu item. Translate only "Ctrl" and "Shift", as Windows names those keys on a keyboard of your language.

data.name: ChoosePhotosKeys
data.comment: Choose photos' shortcut as a screen reader names it. Translate only "Control" and "Shift".

data.name: NewProjectShortcut
data.comment: New project's shortcut in its tooltip. Translate only "Ctrl".

data.name: NewProjectKeys
data.comment: New project's shortcut as a screen reader names it. Translate only "Control".

data.name: ExportShortcut
data.comment: Export video's shortcut in its tooltip. Translate only "Ctrl".

data.name: PlayKeys
data.comment: The preview's play key, the space bar: in the play button's tooltip and as a screen reader names it. The name Windows gives the space bar on a keyboard of your language ("Leertaste" in German).

data.name: BackKeys
data.comment: The key of the Settings page's Back button as a screen reader names it: the Escape key, as Windows names it in your language ("Esc" in German, "Échap" in French).
